Package arztis.econnector.rest.utilities

Class ElgaTypeConverter

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.rest.utilities.ElgaTypeConverter
public class ElgaTypeConverter
extends java.lang.Object
This class contains utilities to convert HL7 V2 data types to classes and to convert classes to HL7 FHIR resources.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth

  • Method Details

    • createFhirBundleOfDocumentResponseType

      public static FhirBundle createFhirBundleOfDocumentResponseType​(java.util.List<org.openhealthtools.ihe.xds.response.DocumentEntryResponseType> documentResponses)
      Creates FhirBundle of passed document responses. This method adds a set of resources to FhirBundle. This resources are extracted from passed documentResponses. Extracted resources are:
      • FhirDocumentReference
      • FhirPractitioner
      • FhirPractitionerRole
      • FhirOrganization
      Parameters:
      documentResponses - list of response
      Returns:
      created FhirBundle

    • createFhirBundleOfRegistryObjectToMetadata

      public static FhirBundle createFhirBundleOfRegistryObjectToMetadata​(RegistryObjectListType registryObject)
      Creates FhirBundle of passed registryObject. This method adds a set of resources to FhirBundle. This resources are extracted from passed registryObject. Extracted resources are:
      • FhirDocumentReference
      • Patient
      • FhirPractitioner
      • FhirPractitionerRole
      • FhirOrganization
      Parameters:
      registryObject - response with document metadata
      Returns:
      created FhirBundle

    • extractErrorMessageOfEmedReturn

      public static FhirBundle extractErrorMessageOfEmedReturn​(java.lang.String xmlCode)
      Creates FhirBundle with error details that are extracted from passed xmlCode. The EMED error code and human readable text is extracted and added to bundle. XML code looks as follows: 
        
   <EmedReturn version=1.0>
       <code>EMED-021002</code>
       <text>Die angegebene eMED-ID ist ungültig.</text>
   </EmedReturn>
      Parameters:
      xmlCode - String with XML formatted code
      Returns:
      created FhirBundle
